d: Night with moon and starry sky. Terrace over the house of Eccletic with tower in the middle, or is mirrored, and a large canochial on two stands. Four lights illuminating the terrace. Eccletic and four schoolchildren.
Good faith and saying.
The schoolchildren come out of the mirror, and bow to Good faith.
Ecclectic, then Ernesto and Cecco.
Ernesto and Cecco.
I'm all alone.
Room in the house of Buonafede with open loggia, coffee table with lights and chairs. Clarice and Flaminia.
Clarice, then Good faith.
Good faith, then Lisetta.
Good faith, then eccletic.
Eccletic and Good Faith. Then Clarice and Lisetta.

Delicious garden in the house of Eccleticus, depicted in the world of the moon, where are represented some extravagance ordered by the astrologer to disappoint Good faith. Good faith sleeping on a bed of flowers. Eccletic disguised with capricious dress. Ernesto in his clothes.
Eccletic and Good Faith sleeping.

Four Knights with Paggi and Staffieri, who wear dresses to disguise Good Faith, and sayings. While the Knights sing the choir, the Paggi take off his clothes to Good Faith, and dress him with the capricious clothes they bring.
Good faith alone.

You can see at the end of the scene a triumphal chariot, pulled by four men bizarrely dressed, with over the chariot Cecco, dressed as emperor, and at the foot of the same Ernesto, dressed as a hero, with a star on his forehead.
Good faith and Ernesto.
Good faith alone, and various people inside that form the echo.
Eccletic and Lisetta conducted by two, with blindfolded eyes.
Lisetta, then Good faith.
Cecco in the dress of fake emperor with Séguito; then Buonafede and Lisetta.
Ballet sounds come in Flaminia and Clarice car. Good faith helps them to get down; Cecco and Lisetta remain on the throne, and Ernesto and Eccletico arrive in the meantime.
Cecco and Lisetta on the throne; Good faith, Eccletic and Clarice.
Good faith; Cecco and Lisetta enthroned.
Ecclectic with Knights and Servants, and sayings.
Ernesto and the two Paggi who return carrying on two basins a scepter and a crown, and sayings.
Clarice, Flaminia and sayings.
Room in the house of the Eccletic. Good faith, Eccletic, Ernesto, and Cecco with the former clothes.
Ecclectic in the act of following Good faith, and Clarice.
Everyone.
